headlines.title: Southern Company reports third-quarter 2026 earnings
headlines.summary: Southern Company today reported third-quarter earnings of $2.0 billion, or $1.77 per share, in 2026 compared with earnings of $1.7 billion, or $1.55 per share, in the third quarter of 2025. For the nine months ended September 30, 2026, Southern Company reported earnings of $4.6 billion, or $4.02 per share, compared with $3.9 billion, or $3.56 per share, for the same period in 2025.

headlines.title: How Will Southern Stock React To Its Upcoming Earnings?
headlines.summary: Southern (NYSE:SO) is scheduled to report its earnings on Thursday, November 5, 2026. The company has a market value of about $106.6 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $30.2 billion in revenue and $7.3 billion in operating profit, with net income of $4.7 billion.

description: The Southern Company, through its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of electricity. The company offers electric service to retail customers and wholesale customers; and energy-related products and services to natural gas choice markets. It also develops, constructs, acquires, owns, operates, and manages power generation assets, as well as battery energy storage projects; sells electricity at market-based rates in the wholesale market; and deploys microgrids for commercial, industrial, governmental, and utility customers. In addition, the company is involved in the distribution of natural gas in Illinois, Georgia, Virginia, and Tennessee; distributes energy and resilience solutions; and invests in telecommunications. The Southern Company was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
